content.text: Production-ready 2D pixel art for a fixed-camera three-quarter top-down dark fantasy dungeon game. Match the supplied Overbless pixel-art references: crisp hard pixel clusters, readable silhouette at 128 pixels, dark navy outlines, restrained cyan/purple/orange accents, no antialiasing, no blur, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Use a perfectly flat pure magenta #ff00ff background around every isolated object. Create a strict 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet with eight separate isolated final-room and run-summary presentation assets, one centered in each equal cell with wide magenta gutters. Row 1: 1) final encounter exit portal closed, gold frame and dark center; 2) same portal opening with cyan light; 3) same portal fully open; 4) overblessed resonance enemy badge combining three small blessing marks without text. Row 2: 5) resonance spawn floor crack burst; 6) final encounter room objective crest; 7) run complete victory crest; 8) run failed defeat crest. Dark fantasy pixel art, restrained cyan, purple and gold accents, dark navy outlines. Every cell exactly one asset, no text, no borders, no labels.
